caseNameFull: L. Santiago Carmona, composing the Workmen's Relief Commission of Porto Rico v. American Railroad Company of Porto Rico
attorneys: Mr. F. G. Munson and Mr. Grant T. Trent for appellants. Mr. Francis H. Dexter and Mr. H. Lewis Brown for appellee.

opinions.text:
Motion to transfer this cause to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the First Circuit granted, *568pursuant to the Act of Congress of September 14, 1922, c. 305, 42 Stat. 837.
